skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Apply theoretical knowledge to solve practical problems in project management.
Develop skills to conduct research, analyze, and synthesize issues related to project management.
Enhance organizational discipline, dynamism, cooperation, and personal responsibility in group work.
Develop the ability to work independently and self-study to improve project management expertise.
Identify and solve problems with a systematic approach in project management.
Improve the ability to analyze and solve problems in project management.
Improve communication skills in a professional setting.
